description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Elegant Edgecrafters, adding {C}{C}.
Elegant Edgecrafters dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Elegant Edgecrafters from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Elegant Edgecrafters enters the battlefield, creating two 1/1 Servo creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
